section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Functional Test and Adjustment
title: Condenser Motor
ocr_text:
Condenser Motor

(See page AC-9)

ON-VEHICLE INSPECTION

1. CHECK CONDENSER MOTOR OPERATION
NOTE: When the air conditioner is on, the condenser motor must rotate.

2. CHECK A/C RELAY OPERATION
NOTE: When the air conditioner is on, the A/C relay must come on.
If a problem is found, replace defective part.
